title: Kinetically Aerated Canadian Snapper Fish Tagine
description: A fermented and aerated Canadian dish featuring snapper fish, cooked in a clay pot, this recipe is nut-free-friendly and perfect for a unique dinner experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the snapper fish with salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in the clay pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the clay pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the ginger to the clay pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the snapper fish to the clay pot and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
Add the lemon juice to the clay pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the clay pot to the preheated oven and cook for 15 minutes.
Remove the clay pot from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the snapper fish hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
